title: test(example-todo): boot the MCP action drive with its Default Organization and run it in the example suite
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XCt3ZdY2VYJxnxbVoW2sm2m)_

Fixes #30928

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`examples/app-todo` 的 MCP 业务动作端到端脚本改成普通 vitest 测试 `test/mcp-actions.test.ts`,随该示例自己的 `pnpm test` 在 CI 里跑;启动时挂上 plugin-auth 的身份对象(`createIdentityObjectsPlugin()`),于是装机在种子加载前就有默认组织。原 `test:mcp` 脚本删除。
- 为什么改:原脚本在 `main` 上第 3 步失败(「Organization is required」):它的内核不注册组织对象，种子和系统写入都被拒;且没有任何流水线跑它。卡片要求「修好启动，再接入一条会跑的流水线或证明已有覆盖后删除」:实测没有重复覆盖，选接入。
- 风险与回滚：只动私有示例包、一处测试注释和锁文件里一条 workspace 依赖链接;不改平台代码、不发布。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:① `examples/app-todo/test/mcp-actions.test.ts` 的 `beforeAll` 启动顺序与第一条用例(默认组织与种子);② `examples/app-todo/vitest.config.ts`(三个平台包按源码解析);③ `examples/app-todo/package.json`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo exec vitest run test/mcp-actions.test.ts`,预期 9 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The manual `test:mcp` script now boots with an organization and runs in a lane.**

- **Boot.** On `main` (re-measured at `4c318214`) `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo test:mcp` exits 1 at step 3: the app seed and the step-3 insert are refused with `Organization is required`. The kernel registered no organization object, so nothing created the Default Organization a `single` install holds before seeds load (ADR-0131 D3/D9). The suite now mounts `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` from `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: plugin-auth's identity objects with the same Default Organization invariant `AuthPlugin.start()` keeps, and no authentication mounted. This is the reduced-kernel composition plugin-auth's `identity-objects-plugin.ts` header documents for an app's own test suite, and `AppPlugin` already orders it ahead of its seed. No platform package changes.
- **Wired, not deleted.** `test/mcp-actions.e2e.ts` (a `tsx` script) becomes `test/mcp-actions.test.ts` (vitest; a pure rename commit first, then the conversion). The default vitest include picks it up, so it runs in the example's own `pnpm test`, which CI's Test Core shards run. The `test:mcp` package script is removed. Each step is one case with `expect` assertions in place of the script's `check()` counter; step state no longer leaks between cases (steps 5 and 6 seed their own task).
- **Source aliases.** `examples/app-todo/vitest.config.ts` stops re-exporting the shared preset and declares anchored array-form aliases that resolve `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/runtime` and `@objectstack/plugin-auth` to their `src/index.ts`, because `pnpm check:test-source-alias` refused the new suite's three `dist/` imports (measured red, exit 1, on the first head). It keeps `disableConsoleIntercept: true` itself, as `examples/app-crm/vitest.config.ts` does, because `check:console-intercept-disarm` judges only a bare preset re-export as the preset.
- **Same boot for `test/seed-check.ts`** (bounded in-place fix, same defect class, same file family): the second manual `tsx` script exited 1 on `main` with the same eight `Organization is required` seed refusals; with `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` mounted it prints `Found Tasks: 8` and exits 0. No lane runs it, and the new first case of the suite pins the same seed rows.
- **New pin.** A first case asserts the boot holds exactly one organization and that the app's own seed landed (`Learn ObjectStack`, `Build a cool app`): the card's failure, pinned.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` is added as a `workspace:*` devDependency of `@objectstack/example-todo`, with its `pnpm-lock.yaml` importer link (3 lines, generated by `pnpm install`).
- Path pointers to the old file name move with it: the example README (and its run command), `test/node-shim.d.ts`, `test/task-completion-trigger.test.ts`, and the one comment line in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` that names this file as where the confirmation gate's two halves run together (comment only; on the claim's amended surface).

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-todo exec vitest run test/mcp-actions.test.ts`: **9 passed (9)**; the file line reads 906 ms (default reporter, file time).
- Example suite in `examples/app-todo` on the final head (with the source aliases): Test Files 9 passed (9), Tests 249 passed (249), exit 0. `pnpm typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, includes `test/**`): exit 0.
- `packages/mcp`: `vitest run src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` 6 passed (6) (comment-only edit).
- `tsx test/seed-check.ts`: exit 1 before (eight seed refusals), exit 0 after (`Found Tasks: 8`).
- **Red-first** (one-time proof, committed head first; run on the first head and again on the final head with the source aliases, same reading): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` of the `createIdentityObjectsPlugin()` line landed (anchor 1 -> 0, blob `08e51a7e` -> `e95cbeaa`), the file then read **5 failed | 4 passed**: the new boot case (`Object 'sys_organization' not found`) and steps 3, 5, 6, 7 (`ValidationError: Organization is required`, the card's failure). Restored: blob == HEAD `08e51a7e`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

**Coverage measured before choosing (the card's "name which one").** The candidates that drive actions over MCP with more than a stubbed bridge:

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts` and `mcp-action-tools.test.ts` drive the real `MCPServerRuntime` door, but over a bridge double; the first file's header names this script as the only place the door and the runtime gate run together against a real engine.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-confirmation-gate.test.ts` pins the gate predicate by calling `invokeBusinessAction` directly, without the MCP door.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/mcp-system-object-action-exposure.dogfood.test.ts` drives `list_actions` / `run_action` through live MCP on a booted showcase, including a 428 refusal and the confirmed call, but only for platform `sys_user` actions of `type: 'api'` (a forward), and dogfood does not run in PR CI. `mcp-delete-record-confirmation.dogfood.test.ts` is the `delete_record` tool, not `run_action`.

None drives an app's `type: 'script'` action with a registered handler, the `requiredPermissions` gate (ADR-0066 D4), or the `ai.exposed` gate on an app object through `MCPServerRuntime` → `HttpDispatcher.buildMcpBridge` → a real engine and driver. So no duplicate exists at a layer as close to the code, and the script is wired, not deleted.

**Why this boot and not the example testkit.** `test/default-organization.testkit.ts` (`installDefaultOrganization`) registers the organization after the engine is up and writes the row through the driver. Measured: called after `kernel.bootstrap()` it is too late for `AppPlugin`'s seed (eight `Organization is required` seed refusals at boot), and step 3 is then refused with `SystemWriteOrganizationRequiredError` because the engine memoised the empty organization probe during the seed. The plugin creates the organization in `start()`, ahead of the seed, the way a real install does.

`@objectstack/example-todo` is `private: true` and ships nothing; the only non-example file is a test-file comment in `packages/mcp` (not in that package's `files[]`), so `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on the final head, each exit captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`, on head `e2ebb1ea`:

- **64 derived, 64 run, exit 0 each.** `--ran`: "64 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
- The first run of the union (head `59c1bd94`) read `pnpm check:test-source-alias` red (exit 1, the three new `dist/` imports); the source aliases are the fix, and the second run is green.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed its pinned fixture on this shallow clone (`git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876`), then exit 0.
- Gate record: one `COMMAND :: exit N` line per family, kept with the seat.

Scoped lint: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config examples/app-todo packages/mcp/src/mcp-action-confirmation-member.test.ts`, exit 0.

CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
